editorial:
Imagine waking up and realizing you are being blamed for a murder you never even did. Now imagine you have to run for your life with three other people you have never met in your life. That is exactly how things kick off here. You get to follow these four strangers as they try to survive and clear their names while everyone is hunting them down. The vibe is very tense and keeps you guessing about who you can actually trust, making you feel like you are right there in the middle of the chase with them.

What really works here is how the movie keeps the energy high. The action scenes are punchy and the twists keep you on your toes. While some of the dialogue feels a bit stiff at times, the chemistry between the group makes up for it. If you love a good mystery with a lot of running and hiding, you will enjoy this. You should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or if you love owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call.
endingExplained: In the final act, you find out that the group was framed by a powerful person who wanted to cover up their own crimes. The strangers stop running and decide to fight back together. They manage to trap the real killer and force a confession. The movie ends with the police arriving to arrest the true villain, and the four strangers finally get their freedom and their lives back.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves conspiracy thrillers and escape stories.
